subject: general
question: A recipe needs 3 cups of flour to make 12 muffins. How many cups of flour are needed to make 20 muffins in the same proportion?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Muffins to Flour ratio = 12 : 3 = 4 : 1

This means 4 muffins require 1 cup of flour.

Required flour for 20 muffins = 20 ÷ 4 = 5 cups

**∴ Answer = 5 cups**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Flour₁ = 3 cups, Muffins₁ = 12

Muffins₂ = 20, Flour₂ = x

**Formula used:**

Direct Proportion: Flour₁ ÷ Muffins₁ = Flour₂ ÷ Muffins₂

 12 Muffins 3 Cups 20 Muffins x Cups 
• 
• Ratio: 12 ÷ 3 = 20 ÷ x 

**Calculations:**

Using the proportion method:

⇒ 3 ÷ 12 = x ÷ 20

⇒ 1 ÷ 4 = x ÷ 20

⇒ x = 20 ÷ 4

⇒ x = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5 cups.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportion

When two quantities increase or decrease together, they are in direct proportion. Formula: y = k × x or y₁/x₁ = y₂/x₂.

Inverse Proportion

When one quantity increases as the other decreases. Formula: x × y = k or x₁ × y₁ = x₂ × y₂.

Unitary Method

A technique where you first find the value of a single unit and then multiply by the required number of units.
